svg.title: 买油改变费用，开车改变城市与剩油
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"买油改变费用，开车改变城市与剩油","steps":[{"caption":"补充小例：容量四，只展示一条最优方案，从城市 0、空油箱开始。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":0,"fuel":0,"cost":0}},{"caption":"在 0 买一单位油，费用加 5；仍在同城。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":0,"fuel":1,"cost":5}},{"caption":"再买一单位，剩油 2，累计费用 10。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":0,"fuel":2,"cost":10}},{"caption":"行驶两单位到城市 1，消耗油但不再付费。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":1,"fuel":0,"cost":10}},{"caption":"城市 1 油价更低，买一单位只加 1。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":1,"fuel":1,"cost":11}},{"caption":"再买一单位后有 2 单位油，总费用 12。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":1,"fuel":2,"cost":12}},{"caption":"开到城市 2，用掉剩油，费用仍为 12；无需在出发时加满。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"city":2,"fuel":0,"cost":12}}]}

g.text: 买油改变费用，开车改变城市与剩油
容量 4；在城市 0 直接买满走直路需要 20，这条方案只需 12。
